metadata.name: [GCP Compute OTel] Memory pressure across a zone
metadata.description: Alerts when multiple VMs in a zone are under memory pressure: at least 95% of guest RAM in use (balloon driver view) or sustained swap-in of at least 1 MiB/s, averaged over 15 minutes. Fleet-level by design. Returns one row per breaching project and zone.

query.base:
TS metrics-gcp.compute.otel-*
// Compute Engine VM instances only
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gce_instance"
// Hypervisor (balloon driver) view of guest memory; no guest agent required.
// swap_*_bytes_count are DELTA metrics stored as gauges (bytes per 60s sample) and are only emitted for some machine families.
// OTel TSDS can split one entity's history into several series (_metric_names_hash is a dimension).
// Collapse to one row per minute first, then: means = SUM(sums) / SUM(counts); latest value = LAST(x, minute).
| STATS
    ram_used_sum = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used`)),
    ram_used_n = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used`)),
    ram_size = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_size`)),
    swap_sum = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_in_bytes_count`)),
    swap_n = SUM(COUNT_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_in_bytes_count`))
  BY minute = TBUCKET(1 minute), resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.zone, resource.attributes.instance_id, attributes.instance_name
// RAM size: the latest value by timestamp (a VM can be resized)
| STATS
    ram_used_sum = SUM(ram_used_sum), ram_used_n = SUM(ram_used_n),
    ram_size = LAST(ram_size, minute) WHERE ram_size IS NOT NULL,
    swap_sum = SUM(swap_sum), swap_n = SUM(swap_n)
  BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.zone, resource.attributes.instance_id, attributes.instance_name
| WHERE ram_size > 0 AND ram_used_n > 0
| EVAL
    ram_used = TO_DOUBLE(ram_used_sum) / ram_used_n,
    swap_in_bps = CASE(swap_n > 0, TO_DOUBLE(swap_sum) / swap_n / 60.0, 0.0)
| EVAL mem_used_pct = ram_used * 100.0 / ram_size
// Per-VM pressure: >= 95% RAM used OR >= 1 MiB/s sustained swap-in. Tune both to your environment.
| EVAL is_pressured = mem_used_pct >= 95 OR swap_in_bps >= 1048576
| STATS
    instances = COUNT(*),
    pressured_instances = COUNT(*) WHERE is_pressured,
    max_mem_used_pct = ROUND(MAX(mem_used_pct), 1),
    max_swap_in_bps = ROUND(MAX(swap_in_bps), 0),
    pressured_instance_names = VALUES(attributes.instance_name) WHERE is_pressured
  BY resource.attributes.project_id, resource.attributes.zone
| EVAL pressured_pct = ROUND(pressured_instances * 100.0 / instances, 1)

data.content:
## Memory pressure across a zone

Several VMs in this zone are close to their RAM limit (>= 95% used, per the hypervisor balloon driver) or are actively swapping memory in. Sustained swap-in means the guest is overcommitted and performance is degrading.

### Triage
1. Review the listed instances: is memory growth tied to traffic growth or a recent deployment (possible leak)?
2. Check swap-in versus swap-out. Steady swap-in means pages are being faulted back in, which usually means memory thrashing.
3. Check CPU utilisation on the same VMs: thrashing often inflates CPU and disk I/O.
4. These are hypervisor-side metrics. Confirm in-guest memory (processes, page cache, OOM kills) with a guest agent or host logs before acting.

### Remediation
Resize to a machine type with more memory, scale out the instance group, or fix the memory-hungry workload.

### Tuning
`mem_used_pct >= 95`, `swap_in_bps >= 1048576`, and the fleet condition `pressured_pct >= 10 AND pressured_instances >= 2` are all adjustable. Swap metrics are emitted only for some machine families; missing swap data counts as zero. GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics typically arrive several minutes late, so the most recent minutes of the lookback window may be empty; the window is sized to tolerate this.
